en.name: Worthing Pier
en.text: A Grade II listed Art Deco pier built in 1862, offering views of the English Channel and hosting a theatre.

en.name: Worthing Beach
en.text: The long pebble beach of Worthing provides the perfect stage for a traditional British coastal holiday. An extensive promenade invites relaxing walks with views of the waves. Water sports enthusiasts will find ample space for their outdoor activities here. It is well worth taking a deep breath of the sea breeze after a windy day.

en.text: An elegant 1930s neo-Georgian building serving as the administrative heart of the borough.

en.name: Brooklands Park

en.name: Denton Gardens

en.name: Marine Gardens
en.text: A classic English garden featuring putting greens, a restaurant, and beautiful floral displays.

en.text: Located right on the coast, this traditional entertainment area promises pure enjoyment. With carousels and classic fairground attractions, the Lido magically attracts families and children in particular. The cheerful and nostalgic atmosphere makes a visit a joyful experience. A great place for anyone looking for that lively British seaside feeling.

descriptionAdvanced.de: Worthing ist eine wohlhabende Küstenstadt in West Sussex, die sich ihren Charakter als klassisches englisches Seebad bewahrt hat. Im Gegensatz zu den oft lebhafteren Nachbarorten wie Brighton zeichnet sich Worthing durch eine ruhige, familiäre Atmosphäre aus. Die Stadt erlebte ihren Aufstieg im 19. Jahrhundert als beliebter Badeort für wohlhabende Londoner, was sich in der erhaltenen Architektur widerspiegelt. Der berühmte Worthing Pier und die ausgedehnte Promenade sind Zentren des öffentlichen Lebens. Die Stadt ist auch bekannt für ihre Gartenbau-Tradition, da das Klima an der Südküste besonders mild ist. Heute ist Worthing ein wichtiger Wohnort für Pendler, die die Nähe zur Küste und die gute Infrastruktur schätzen.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Worthing egy klasszikus angol tengerparti üdülőhely West Sussexben, amely az 1700-as évek végén vált népszerűvé a brit arisztokrácia körében. A város egyik legfontosabb szimbóluma az 1862-ben megnyitott történelmi móló (Worthing Pier), amely az Art Deco stílusú pavilonjával ma is a sétány központi eleme. A tengerparti sétány kilométereken át húzódik a La Manche-csatorna mentén, lehetőséget adva a friss tengeri levegő élvezetére és a látványos naplementék megtekintésére. Worthing kulturális élete is gazdag, több színháznak és a Dome mozinak – az ország egyik legrégebbi mozijának – ad otthont. A közeli South Downs Nemzeti Park és a város környéki krétahegyek kiváló túrázási lehetőségeket kínálnak. Enyhe klímája és nyugodt légköre miatt különösen kedvelt a családok és a pihenni vágyó idősebb generációk körében.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Worthing este un oraș de coastă prosper în West Sussex, care și-a păstrat caracterul de stațiune engleză clasică. Spre deosebire de localitățile vecine mai animate precum Brighton, Worthing se remarcă printr-o atmosferă liniștită, familială. Orașul a cunoscut ascensiunea în secolul al XIX-lea ca stațiune populară pentru londonezii înstăriți, lucru reflectat în arhitectura conservată. Celebru debarcader Worthing Pier și promenada extinsă sunt centre ale vieții publice. Orașul este de asemenea cunoscut pentru tradiția sa în horticultură, deoarece climatul de pe coasta de sud este deosebit de blând. Astăzi, Worthing este o zonă rezidențială importantă pentru navetiști care apreciază proximitatea față de coastă și infrastructura bună.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Worthing is a prosperous seaside town in West Sussex that has retained its character as a classic English seaside resort. Unlike the often livelier neighboring towns such as Brighton, Worthing is known for its calm, family-friendly atmosphere. The town rose to prominence in the 19th century as a popular seaside resort for wealthy Londoners, which is reflected in the preserved architecture. The famous Worthing Pier and the extensive promenade are centers of public life. The town is also known for its horticultural tradition, as the climate on the south coast is particularly mild. Today, Worthing is an important residential area for commuters who appreciate the proximity to the coast and good infrastructure.
